definitions.tps: Arithmetic mean of 8 logged per-request decode rates per run, then mean across repetitions. Raw TPS is printed to 0.001 tokens/s.
definitions.ttft: Maximum of 8 prompt-completion times per run, then mean across repetitions, in seconds.
definitions.decode_time: For each request: 1000 * logged decode seconds / logged timed tokens. Mean within run, then across repetitions. Uses logged elapsed durations, never the reciprocal of a mean TPS.
definitions.time_saved: Base elapsed time minus VNNI elapsed time. Positive means VNNI saved time; negative means it added time.
definitions.rate_per_card_ratio: (TP4 TPS / 4 cards) / (TP2 TPS / 2 cards). A normalization of the measured request rate; not a separate throughput measurement.
definitions.tp_scaling: TP4 means divided by TP2 means for the same prompt and arm. TP4 and TP2 ran in separate campaign phases, with 2 and 3 repetitions respectively.

claude_report.finding: Each prompt row has its own axis range within separate TP2 and TP4 figures. Dot positions and pixel gaps cannot compare absolute TPS across those rows or figures.

codex_review.finding: Each row has an expanded independent linear scale. For most rows the axis span is 1.6 times the baseline-candidate gap, so visually similar pixel gaps do not imply similar changes in tokens/s or milliseconds.

limitations: No per-stage CPU attention or storage-write timing is present in these runs. The cause of different TP2 and TP4 gains remains unresolved.
All repetitions use fixed off/base/vnni/vnnioff order. No balanced arm-order comparison was measured.
TP2 uses 3 repetitions and TP4 uses 2 repetitions. Percentage differences describe this dataset, not a general confidence bound.
